Hello! Your art style is really soft and cute! I would love for you to draw my OC. Her name is Heda. She is confident and sassy.

Here is what she looks like and what I'd like her outfit to be:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14wej2r8Z09mtq8DGysJ0wyt_I1NDqwxg
The other photo is references for the earring, which is not necessary.

I will leave the composition, pose, expressions, and background up to you.
May I please just ask for no "nyan" cat pose and no tongue sticking out expression.

Notes:
- Her facial markings
- Her feathers on the sides of her head
- Her breasts size is B cup

Here is a folder that shows her personality, maybe that might help:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ez1xyMmhjaEOI5OPDjG0XAaCvsNsEXIK

Thank you for considering!

Nice to meet you!
I requested this because I was interested in your picture pattern.
If you don't mind, would it be possible to ask you to draw our OC, "Kirikane Akane"?
The setting is as follows for reference, but you can draw freely.
Akane Kirikane
Akane Kirikane
A blonde-haired, blue-eyed girl with a wavy ponytail. She is a German quarter. She wears a golden arm ring and a purple chou chou on each arm.

She has several aliases, including Red Lightning Demon, Prodigy of the Spinne family, and Witch of Thunderbolt, and has the ability to interfere with lightning and metal.

As a child, she was feared for her mighty power, and was also expected to have a promising future. However, around the time she entered puberty, she suffered from a physical condition that caused her to lose control of her body one time, causing great damage to those around her, and she has been traumatized by this incident.
He is afraid that the aftermath of his lightning ability may cause damage to the people around him, especially in today's world of electronic devices, so he has sealed off his ability himself.
In his battles with enemy demons, he leaves all the fighting to his messenger, a pack of golden spiders (Hyakumei-Sente-no-Oh).
Encouraged by Hina Asahina, he overcame his trauma and defeated an army of enemy large demons single-handedly, but was shot from behind by her, wounding him to death.
With Kirigane Akane dying, the Golden Spider Swarm broke free from her control, preying on Kirigane Akane, taking her power and running amok.
